title: LatchCreateSessionRequestV2
description: The only caller-controlled inputs for a mobile-created session: where it starts, and optionally which hosted agent the Mac launches there instead of a standard shell.

agent.description: Hosted agent to launch directly in the session. Absent means a standard login shell. The Mac resolves the agent's own executable and launch arguments; the caller names only the kind, and only a kind the gateway advertises in features.sessionAgents.

model.description: Model the agent starts with, passed to it as `--model`. Only valid with `agent`, and only an id the gateway lists for that agent at GET /v2/agents/{agent}/models. Absent means the agent's own configured default on the Mac.
